name: org.chat21.android.ui.chat_groups.activities.GroupAdminPanelActivity
description: When a user opens a Chat21 group's details, this screen shows its name, owner, creation time, and members. The group owner can add people, and selecting a member opens that member's group options.
disableEffect: Users would lose the group details and member-management screen, including the group owner's add-member option.
